extKaraokeSyncDescription:
Use this feature when lyrics are out of sync with the video.

1️⃣ Press Start to play the video from the beginning.
2️⃣ Press the button at the exact moment the first lyric starts.
3️⃣ You can try multiple times, so don't worry!
extKaraokeSyncConfirmFaster: {{offset}}{{unit}} faster than original lyrics timestamp. Apply this change?
extKaraokeSyncConfirmSlower: {{offset}}{{unit}} slower than original lyrics timestamp. Apply this change?
extKaraokeSyncSaved: ✅ Sync offset saved! Check it in the sync offset list on the right sidebar.
extAutoDisableMessage: Lyrics feature has been paused due to {{count}} consecutive non-music videos. It will automatically resume when you play a music video.
extAutoDisableNotificationMessage: The lyrics feature has been paused because you haven't watched {{count}} consecutive music videos. It will automatically resume when you watch a music video.
extAcapellaInitialDescription:
To start acapella recording,
please check microphone permission.
extAcapellaInitialHint: 💡 We recommend using headset or earphones.
extAcapellaHeadsetWarning: Playing through speakers will include YouTube audio in recording.
extAcapellaOutputDeviceRecommendation: 💡 We recommend setting headset or earphones as the default output device in your PC settings.
extAcapellaDeleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this recording?
extAcapellaSaveAndLeaveConfirm: Do you want to save the recording before leaving?
extAcapellaSaveSuccess: Recording saved successfully! You can check it in the recordings list.

extAcapellaHeadsetCheckConfirm: Please ensure your headset is set as the default output device in system settings.

extAcapellaMicrophoneConnectionFailed: Cannot use the selected microphone. Please select another microphone or check the connection.

extAcapellaCountdownLocationHint: (Countdown is displayed on the video player)
extTutorialMenuDesc: Choose a feature to learn. You can revisit completed tutorials anytime!
extTutorial1Desc: How to turn karaoke mode on and off with the music note button
extTutorial2Desc: How to match lyrics timing with the music
extTutorial3Desc: How to repeat a specific section
extTutorial4Desc: How to set lyrics display mode and style
extTutorial5Desc: How to use manual search, charts, and other sidebar features
extTutorial6Desc: How to skip intros and jump to the start of the song
extTutorial6Step1Desc: Use Skip Intro to jump past boring intro sections!
extTutorial6Step2Desc: Turn on Auto Skip to automatically skip intros in music videos.
extTutorial6Step3Desc: The Restart Song button takes you back to the beginning of the video!
extTutorialStep2_1Desc: Are the lyrics out of sync? Use the sync button in the bottom bar to fine-tune the display timing.
extTutorialStep2_2Desc: Want to practice a specific section repeatedly? Try the loop section feature!
extTutorialStep3_1Desc: Customize fonts, sizes, colors, and more to create your own unique lyrics style!
extTutorialStep3_2Desc: Choose between Default/Single/Full mode for your preferred lyrics display.
extTutorialStep4_1Desc: Couldn't find lyrics automatically? Search manually in the sidebar!
extTutorialStep4_2Desc: Select a song from the charts and it will search directly on YouTube.
extTutorial2Step1Desc: Lyrics not in sync with the music? Use the sync button to adjust the timing!
extTutorial2Step2Desc: Your sync settings are saved per video and can be managed in the 'Syncset List' in the sidebar!
extTutorial3Step1Desc: Want to practice a difficult section? Use the loop button!
extTutorial3Step2Desc: Press once to repeat the current verse 1 time
extTutorial3Step3Desc: Press twice to repeat the verse 3 times
extTutorial3Step4Desc: Press three times to loop the verse endlessly
extTutorial3Step5Desc: Press once more to cancel the loop
extTutorial3Step6Desc: To loop the entire video, right-click and select loop playback.
extTutorial3Step7Desc: Use prev/next buttons to move between lyrics sections!
extTutorial4Step1Desc: Click the button to change how lyrics are displayed!
extTutorial4Step2Desc: Toggle current lyrics and pronunciation display on/off. Try clicking!
extTutorial4Step3Desc: Press the text effects button to customize font, size, and color!
extTutorial5Step1Desc: If lyrics don't appear or are wrong, search by entering artist and title manually!
extTutorial5Step2Desc: Charts updated hourly! Select a song to go directly to YouTube.
extTutorial5Step3Desc: Record your own voice with acapella recording, and listen back in the recordings list!
extTutorial5Step4Desc: Manage your saved timing settings from the syncset in the bottom bar here.
extEmailDesc: Feel free to contact us via email if you have any questions.
extGithubIssuesDesc: For developers or if you prefer public discussion, please use GitHub Issues.
extSupportProjectDesc: If you enjoy this extension, consider supporting my work!
extLanguageDesc: User interface will be provided in the selected language.
extManualSearchDescription: If automatic matching fails, you can search for lyrics by manually entering the artist and song title.
extManualSearchRateLimitError: Too many requests. Please try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
extManualSearchInputError: Please enter both artist and title.
extManualSearchApiError: An error occurred during search. Please try again.
extLogsExportedSuccess: Logs downloaded as JSON file and copied to clipboard!
extClearLogsConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear all error logs?
extTextEffectsDualDescription: Applies only to Dual lyrics type.
extTextEffectsSingleDescription: Applies only to Single lyrics type. Single uses highlight style for all lyrics.
extTextEffectsFullDescription: Applies only to Full lyrics type.
extTextEffectsPronunciationHighlightHint: 💡 Applies highlight effect when current lyrics disappear and only pronunciation lyrics remain
extTextEffectsGeneralDescription: Configure countdown, lyrics position, and presets.
extTextEffectsCountdownDescription: Shows countdown before first lyrics. Only works in Sync/Single modes.
extTextEffectsPositionDescription: Set the bottom margin of lyrics overlay on screen.
extTextEffectsPresetDescription: Presets include all mode settings (Sync/Single/Full) and general settings.
extTextEffectsPresetDeleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete preset '{{name}}'?
extOnboardingWelcome: Please select the language of the music videos you listen to most often
extOnboardingIncludedHint: These languages are already included and do not require additional downloads.
extOnboardingOptionalHint: Basic romanization is provided for unselected languages. (Accuracy may be lower)
extTutorialStep2: Press the same button to return to normal view while keeping your lyrics and settings!
extLoopContinuousOnDesc: Auto-advance to next section after loop
extSyncSelectSplitHint: Sync will be adjusted from this line to the end
